recognize_zh: A 圖淋巴結中瀰漫的大型淋巴細胞，核不規則、染色質淡、核仁明顯；B 圖 BCL2 強陽性、C 圖 EBER 核陽性；D–F 圖 FISH 顯示 IGH/BCL2 融合訊號同時出現在 EBV 陽性（綠色點狀）的腫瘤細胞內。
features: Panel A (H&E): diffuse sheets of large lymphoid cells with irregular vesicular nuclei and prominent nucleoli, with scattered apoptotic bodies
Panel B: strong cytoplasmic/membranous BCL2 staining in large cells
Panel C: EBER ISH with nuclear positivity in many large cells
Panel D: FISH with multiple green EBV signals within nuclei plus red (5'BCL2) and blue (3'IGH) probes
Panels E-F: single nuclei showing a colocalized red-blue fusion signal (arrowhead) in an EBV-positive cell, and a BCL2 break-apart pattern in an EBV-negative cell
describe_en: Composite figure of a lymph node biopsy. The H&E section (A) shows diffuse effacement by large lymphoid cells with irregular vesicular nuclei, prominent nucleoli, and scattered apoptotic debris. The large cells are strongly BCL2 positive (B) and a large proportion show nuclear EBER positivity by in situ hybridization (C). FISH on paraffin sections (D-F) demonstrates punctate EBV genome signals within nuclei together with IGH::BCL2 fusion signals (arrowhead), and confirms BCL2 rearrangement in both EBV-positive and EBV-negative tumor cells. Findings are consistent with EBV-positive diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, germinal center type, harboring t(14;18)(q32;q21), with EBV infection likely acquired after the BCL2 rearrangement.

ddx.vs: Typical EBV+ DLBCL is usually non-germinal-center type and lacks t(14;18), whereas this case is CD10+ with IGH::BCL2 fusion by FISH.

ddx.dx: High-grade B-cell lymphoma with MYC and BCL2 rearrangements
ddx.vs: Double-hit lymphoma requires an additional MYC rearrangement, which must be excluded by MYC FISH.
Transformation is supported by a prior or coexisting follicular component, which is not seen in this diffuse field.
Bystander EBV infection involves only scattered small cells, whereas here EBER and FISH EBV signals are present in the large neoplastic cells carrying the fusion.

stain: H&E; IHC: BCL2; ISH: EBER; FISH
